rationale: Source meets T0=11.45 with WS +1.491 ns at max_ss, reg-to-reg, not port-limited; the tool did no timing work. C0=9.9586, R1=10.00, so the rebuild has only 0.041 ns rounding margin. DELAY 0 ABC mapping ignores the clock, so the netlist is unchanged, but timing-driven placement reweights nets (IO delays scale 0.8x vs r2r 1.0x), giving a fresh PnR draw with ~0.1-0.2 ns spread around the source's critical delay. At 10 ns the resizer engages only below 0.025 ns on nominal-RC estimates, while max_ss signoff runs ~0.08 ns worse, so rescued runs often land slightly negative. Hold (+0.094, repairable), DRC (converged to 0) and DRV (0 vs 295) add ~5% risk. Net: mild lean to pass; claim roughly target-insensitive (slope ~0). Chain most likely keeps 10.00 (pass then stop/fail at 9.95, or fail then a step-back near 10.1).
